title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
diagnostic_steps: Inspect database connection pool utilization metric (active vs max connections).
Check for unclosed connections, hanging transactions, or long-running queries.
Verify database server CPU, memory, and max_connections limit.
Check recent application deployments for unclosed database sessions or connection leaks.
Inspect network latency and firewall states between application and database cluster.
recommended_remediation: Address identified connection leak in application code; release lingering idle transactions.
Temporarily increase pool size (max_connections) if database server capacity permits.
Adjust connection timeout and idle timeout parameters to prevent indefinite blocking.
Gracefully restart affected service pods sequentially only after confirming safe failover conditions.
Verify pool recovery via Prometheus metrics before marking incident resolved.
